items.title: Onto Innovation Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Record Revenues
items.summary: ONTO topped Q2 2026 estimates with record revenue, a backlog above $1 billion and stronger advanced packaging demand. It raised its second-half 2026 outlook.

items.title: FUJIY Q1 Earnings Fall Y/Y on Bio CDMO Costs, Revenues Rise
items.summary: FUJIFILM's Q1 revenue hit a record yen 826.5 billion, but earnings fell 30% as Bio CDMO costs and restructuring weighed on profitability.

items.title: Fortive Raises 2026 Outlook as Core Growth and Cash Flow Accelerate
items.summary: Fortive raises its 2026 earnings outlook as broad organic growth, margin expansion and stronger cash flow support second-half momentum.

items.title: Is Fortive Stock a Buy as Growth Improves but Valuation Limits Upside?
items.summary: Fortive's faster growth, wider margins and stronger cash flow bolster its case, but near-normal valuation and execution risks may limit upside

items.title: FTV Q2 Deep Dive: Organic Growth, Margin Expansion, and Strategic Product Investments
items.summary: Industrial technology company Fortive (NYSE:FTV) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.9% year on year to $1.10 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.74 per share was 4.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 1 Surging  Stock with Competitive Advantages and 2 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: The stocks in this article are all trading near their 52-week highs. This strength often reflects positive developments such as new product launches, favorable industry trends, or improved financial performance.

items.title: SONY Q1 Earnings & Sales Rise on Gaming & Sensors, FY26 View Lifted
items.summary: Sony raises fiscal 2026 guidance after Q1 EPS climbed 35%, sales rose 8.2% and operating margin expanded to 16.8%, led by sensors and music.

items.title: How Investors May Respond To Fortive (FTV) Earnings Beat, Buybacks And Higher Full‑Year EPS Outlook
